# Axy Lusion

> AI art, video, and music portfolio by Kol Tregaskes.

A creative AI portfolio showcasing work made with Midjourney, Suno, Runway, Kling, and other generative tools. Includes ranked tool comparisons and a curated creative AI tools directory.

## Key pages

- [Gallery](https://axylusion.com/gallery.html): AI-generated artwork
- [Videos](https://axylusion.com/videos.html): AI motion and animation
- [Music](https://axylusion.com/music.html): AI-generated tracks via Suno
- [Store](https://axylusion.com/store.html): Licensable trailer cues and promo beds on ElevenLabs Marketplace
- [Tools](https://axylusion.com/tools.html): Recommended AI creative tools
- [A-List](https://axylusion.com/a-list.html): Benchmark-backed rankings of creative AI tools
- [News](https://axylusion.com/news.html): Creative AI news archive
- [RSS](https://axylusion.com/feed.xml): News stories and dated digests
- [Sitemap](https://axylusion.com/sitemap.xml): Public pages and gallery images
- [About](https://axylusion.com/about.html): About the project

## Tool rankings (The A-List)

Published Artificial Analysis arena Elo for image generation, image editing, text-to-video, and voice. Music, 3D, and upscaling are omitted until a current public Elo board exists. The retrieval date is on the A-List page.

## Related sites

- AI Resource Hub: Model comparison and benchmarks
- Kol's Korner: AI news and essays
- Ghost in the Models: AI agent-written articles

## Contact

- X/Twitter: https://x.com/Axylusion
